import json
import re

files = [
    r"C:\Users\psh93\OneDrive\Desktop\Nova_log_data_validation\.assistant\skills\anomaly_detection_templates\od_template.html",

]

for filepath in files:
    print(f"\n{'='*80}")
    print(f"FILE: {filepath.split(chr(92))[-1]}")
    print('='*80)
    
    with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        content = f.read()
    
    # Find all JSON objects in script tags that define cells
    # Pattern: var varName = {...};
    pattern = r'var\s+\w+\s*=\s*({.*?});(?=\s*<)'
    matches = re.findall(pattern, content, re.DOTALL)
    
    if not matches:

    # Try parsing as JSON cells
    pattern = r'var\s+\w+Cell\s*=\s*({[^}]*?"command"[^}]*?})'
    cell_matches = re.findall(pattern, content, re.DOTALL)
    
    for i, match in enumerate(cell_matches[:5]):
        print(f"\nCell {i}: {match[:200]}...")

--- CELL 1 ---
%md
# OD (Object Detection) 이상 탐지 분석 템플릿
> 전체 셀을 순서대로 실행하세요. 데이터 준비 셀이 temp view `bbox3d_events`를 생성한 후, 각 STEP이 이를 참조합니다.

--- CELL 2 ---
%sql
-- 데이터 준비: raw 테이블에서 bbox3d 이벤트를 파싱하여 temp view 생성
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW bbox3d_events AS
WITH raw_parsed AS (
  SELECT
    e._id                                         AS event_id,
    e._raw:source::STRING                         AS event_source,
    e._raw:type::STRING                           AS event_type,
    to_timestamp(e._raw:time::STRING)             AS event_time,
    DATE(to_timestamp(e._raw:time::STRING))       AS event_date,
    e._raw:sessionid::STRING                      AS session_id,
    to_timestamp(e._occurred_at)                  AS occurred_at,
    e._raw:data.user.id::STRING                   AS user_id,
    e._raw:data.user.name::STRING                 AS user_name,
    e._raw:data.project.dataset_id::STRING        AS dataset_id,
    e._raw:data.project.task_id::STRING           AS task_id,
    e._raw:data.feature::STRING                   AS feature,
    e._raw:data.action::STRING                    AS action,
    e._raw:data.input_type::STRING                AS input_type,
    from_json(
      e._raw:data.changes::STRING,
      'ARRAY<STRUCT<
        object_id:   INT,
        object_type: STRING,
        action:      STRING,
        old:         STRING,
        new:         STRING
      >>'
    ) AS changes,
    from_json(
      e._raw:data.targets::STRING,
      'ARRAY<STRING>'
    ) AS targets
  FROM sv_nova_dev_an2_catalog.raw.raw_labelit__workspace_command e
  WHERE e._raw:type::STRING NOT IN ('history.undo', 'history.redo')
    AND e._raw:data.changes IS NOT NULL
    AND e._raw:data.changes != '[]'
    AND e._raw:data.feature::STRING = 'bbox3d'
)
SELECT
  event_id, event_source, event_type, event_time, event_date,
  session_id, occurred_at, user_id, user_name, dataset_id, task_id,
  feature, action, input_type,
  c.object_id, c.object_type, c.action AS change_action,
  c.old AS old_val, c.new AS new_val, targets
FROM raw_parsed
LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(changes) AS c

--- CELL 3 ---
%sql
-- STEP 0: 데이터 개요
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT object_id) AS object_count
FROM bbox3d_events
GROUP BY event_type
ORDER BY event_count DESC

--- CELL 4 ---
%sql
-- STEP 1: 위치 점프 (이동거리 > 1.0m ⚠️ / > 3.0m ❌)
WITH movements AS (
  SELECT session_id, object_id, event_time,
         get_json_object(old_val, '$.position[0]') AS old_x,
         get_json_object(old_val, '$.position[1]') AS old_y,
         get_json_object(old_val, '$.position[2]') AS old_z,
         get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[0]') AS new_x,
         get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[1]') AS new_y,
         get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[2]') AS new_z
  FROM bbox3d_events
  WHERE event_type = 'annotation.bbox3d.transform'
    AND old_val IS NOT NULL AND new_val IS NOT NULL
),
distances AS (
  SELECT session_id, object_id,
         SQRT(POW(CAST(new_x AS DOUBLE) - CAST(old_x AS DOUBLE), 2) +
              POW(CAST(new_y AS DOUBLE) - CAST(old_y AS DOUBLE), 2) +
              POW(CAST(new_z AS DOUBLE) - CAST(old_z AS DOUBLE), 2)) AS distance
  FROM movements
)
SELECT CASE WHEN distance > 3.0 THEN '>3.0m (critical)'
            WHEN distance > 1.0 THEN '1.0-3.0m (warning)'
            ELSE 'normal' END AS severity,
       COUNT(*) AS event_count,
       ROUND(AVG(distance), 4) AS avg_distance,
       ROUND(MAX(distance), 4) AS max_distance
FROM distances
GROUP BY severity

--- CELL 5 ---
%sql
-- STEP 2: 위치·회전 진동 (reversal 비율 기준)
-- OD: 의도적 이동이 많으므로 비율 ≥ 67%일 때 이상으로 판정
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT session_id, object_id, event_time,
         CAST(get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[0]') AS DOUBLE) AS x,
         CAST(get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[1]') AS DOUBLE) AS y,
         CAST(get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[2]') AS DOUBLE) AS z,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, object_id ORDER BY event_time) AS rn
  FROM bbox3d_events
  WHERE event_type = 'annotation.bbox3d.transform'
    AND new_val IS NOT NULL
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT a.session_id, a.object_id, a.rn,
         (b.x - a.x) AS dx, (b.y - a.y) AS dy, (b.z - a.z) AS dz
  FROM ordered a
  JOIN ordered b ON a.session_id = b.session_id AND a.object_id = b.object_id AND b.rn = a.rn + 1
),
direction_changes AS (
  SELECT a.session_id, a.object_id, a.rn,
         CASE WHEN SIGN(a.dx) != SIGN(b.dx) OR SIGN(a.dy) != SIGN(b.dy) OR SIGN(a.dz) != SIGN(b.dz) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reversal
  FROM deltas a
  JOIN deltas b ON a.session_id = b.session_id AND a.object_id = b.object_id AND b.rn = a.rn + 1
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT session_id, object_id, rn,
         SUM(is_reversal) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, object_id ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS reversals_in_window,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, object_id ORDER BY rn ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_size
  FROM direction_changes
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROUND(reversals_in_window / window_size, 2) AS reversal_ratio
  FROM windowed
  WHERE window_size >= 4
)
SELECT session_id                          AS `세션ID`,
       object_id                           AS `객체ID`,
       MAX(reversal_ratio)                 AS `최대_반전비율`,
       MAX(reversals_in_window)            AS `최대_반전횟수`,
       COUNT(*)                            AS `이벤트수`,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 10 AND MAX(reversal_ratio) >= 0.67 THEN '심각'
            WHEN MAX(reversal_ratio) >= 0.67 THEN '주의'
            ELSE '정상' END              AS `심각도`
FROM with_ratio
GROUP BY session_id, object_id
HAVING MAX(reversal_ratio) >= 0.67
ORDER BY `최대_반전비율` DESC, `최대_반전횟수` DESC

--- CELL 6 ---
%sql
-- STEP 3: 시간 괴리 (> 10s ⚠️ / > 30s·음수 ❌)
SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at) < 0 THEN 'negative (critical)'
            WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at) > 30 THEN '>30s (critical)'
            WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at) > 10 THEN '10-30s (warning)'
            ELSE 'normal' END AS severity,
       COUNT(*) AS event_count,
       ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at)), 2) AS avg_diff_seconds,
       MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at)) AS min_diff,
       MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at)) AS max_diff
FROM bbox3d_events
GROUP BY severity
ORDER BY severity

--- CELL 7 ---
%sql
-- STEP 4: yaw 드리프트 (|yaw| < 1E-10 누적증가, E-17↑ 도달 ⚠️)
WITH yaw_vals AS (
  SELECT session_id, object_id, event_time,
         CAST(get_json_object(new_val, '$.rotation[1]') AS DOUBLE) AS yaw
  FROM bbox3d_events
  WHERE event_type = 'annotation.bbox3d.transform'
    AND new_val IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT session_id, object_id,
       MIN(ABS(yaw)) AS min_abs_yaw,
       MAX(ABS(yaw)) AS max_abs_yaw,
       COUNT(*) AS event_count
FROM yaw_vals
WHERE ABS(yaw) < 1E-10 AND ABS(yaw) > 0
GROUP BY session_id, object_id
HAVING MAX(ABS(yaw)) > 1E-17
ORDER BY max_abs_yaw DESC

--- CELL 8 ---
%sql
-- STEP 5: 복수 사용자 동시 편집 (동일 object 복수 사용자 + 시간 겹침 ❌)
WITH object_users AS (
  SELECT object_id, task_id, session_id, user_id,
         MIN(event_time) AS first_edit,
         MAX(event_time) AS last_edit
  FROM bbox3d_events
  WHERE object_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY object_id, task_id, session_id, user_id
)
SELECT object_id, task_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS user_count,
       COLLECT_SET(user_id) AS users,
       MIN(first_edit) AS earliest,
       MAX(last_edit) AS latest
FROM object_users
GROUP BY object_id, task_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) > 1
ORDER BY user_count DESC

%sql
-- STEP 5: 복수 사용자 동시 편집 (동일 object 복수 사용자 + 시간 겹침 ❌)
WITH object_users AS (
  SELECT object_id, task_id, session_id, user_name,
         MIN(event_time) AS first_edit,
         MAX(event_time) AS last_edit
  FROM rmd_events
  WHERE object_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY object_id, task_id, session_id, user_name
)
SELECT object_id, task_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS user_count,
       COLLECT_SET(user_name) AS users,
       MIN(first_edit) AS earliest,
       MAX(last_edit) AS latest
FROM object_users
GROUP BY object_id, task_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) > 1
ORDER BY user_count DESC

================================================================================
ALL CODE CELLS - ld_template.html
================================================================================

--- CELL 1 ---
%md
# LD (Lane Detection) 이상 탐지 분석 템플릿
> 전체 셀을 순서대로 실행하세요. 데이터 준비 셀이 temp view `ld_events`를 생성한 후, 각 STEP이 이를 참조합니다.

--- CELL 2 ---
%sql
-- 데이터 준비: raw 테이블에서 LD 이벤트를 파싱하여 temp view 생성
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW ld_events AS
WITH raw_parsed AS (
  SELECT
    e._id                                         AS event_id,
    e._raw:source::STRING                         AS event_source,
    e._raw:type::STRING                           AS event_type,
    to_timestamp(e._raw:time::STRING)             AS event_time,
    DATE(to_timestamp(e._raw:time::STRING))       AS event_date,
    e._raw:sessionid::STRING                      AS session_id,
    to_timestamp(e._occurred_at)                  AS occurred_at,
    e._raw:data.user.id::STRING                   AS user_id,
    e._raw:data.user.name::STRING                 AS user_name,
    e._raw:data.project.dataset_id::STRING        AS dataset_id,
    e._raw:data.project.task_id::STRING           AS task_id,
    e._raw:data.feature::STRING                   AS feature,
    e._raw:data.action::STRING                    AS action,
    e._raw:data.input_type::STRING                AS input_type,
    from_json(
      e._raw:data.changes::STRING,
      'ARRAY<STRUCT<
        object_id:   INT,
        object_type: STRING,
        action:      STRING,
        old:         STRING,
        new:         STRING
      >>'
    ) AS changes,
    from_json(
      e._raw:data.targets::STRING,
      'ARRAY<STRING>'
    ) AS targets
  FROM sv_nova_dev_an2_catalog.raw.raw_labelit__workspace_command e
  WHERE e._raw:type::STRING NOT IN ('history.undo', 'history.redo')
    AND e._raw:data.changes IS NOT NULL
    AND e._raw:data.changes != '[]'
    AND e._raw:data.feature::STRING = 'ld'
)
SELECT
  event_id, event_source, event_type, event_time, event_date,
  session_id, occurred_at, user_id, user_name, dataset_id, task_id,
  feature, action, input_type,
  c.object_id, c.object_type, c.action AS change_action,
  c.old AS old_val, c.new AS new_val, targets
FROM raw_parsed
LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(changes) AS c

--- CELL 3 ---
%sql
-- STEP 0: 데이터 개요
SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS session_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS user_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT object_id) AS object_count
FROM ld_events
GROUP BY event_type
ORDER BY event_count DESC

--- CELL 4 ---
%sql
-- STEP 1: 위치 점프 (이동거리 > 1.0m ⚠️ / > 3.0m ❌)
WITH point_movements AS (
  SELECT session_id, user_name, object_id, event_time,
         get_json_object(old_val, '$.position[0]') AS old_x,
         get_json_object(old_val, '$.position[1]') AS old_y,
         get_json_object(old_val, '$.position[2]') AS old_z,
         get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[0]') AS new_x,
         get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[1]') AS new_y,
         get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[2]') AS new_z
  FROM ld_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('annotation.point.move', 'annotation.point.move_batch')
    AND old_val IS NOT NULL AND new_val IS NOT NULL
),
distances AS (
  SELECT session_id, user_name, object_id,
         SQRT(POW(CAST(new_x AS DOUBLE) - CAST(old_x AS DOUBLE), 2) +
              POW(CAST(new_y AS DOUBLE) - CAST(old_y AS DOUBLE), 2) +
              POW(CAST(new_z AS DOUBLE) - CAST(old_z AS DOUBLE), 2)) AS distance
  FROM point_movements
)
SELECT CASE WHEN distance > 3.0 THEN '>3.0m (critical)'
            WHEN distance > 1.0 THEN '1.0-3.0m (warning)'
            ELSE 'normal' END AS severity,
       COUNT(*) AS event_count,
       ROUND(AVG(distance), 4) AS avg_distance,
       ROUND(MAX(distance), 4) AS max_distance
FROM distances
GROUP BY severity

--- CELL 5 ---
%sql
-- STEP 2: 위치 진동 (reversal 비율 기준, 이동거리 0.05m 이상만 카운트)
-- LD: 미세 조정이 잦으므로 비율 ≥ 83%일 때만 이상으로 판정
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT session_id, object_id, event_time,
         CAST(get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[0]') AS DOUBLE) AS x,
         CAST(get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[1]') AS DOUBLE) AS y,
         CAST(get_json_object(new_val, '$.position[2]') AS DOUBLE) AS z,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, object_id ORDER BY event_time) AS rn
  FROM ld_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('annotation.point.move', 'annotation.point.move_batch')
    AND new_val IS NOT NULL
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT a.session_id, a.object_id, a.rn,
         (b.x - a.x) AS dx, (b.y - a.y) AS dy, (b.z - a.z) AS dz,
         SQRT(POW(b.x - a.x, 2) + POW(b.y - a.y, 2) + POW(b.z - a.z, 2)) AS move_dist
  FROM ordered a
  JOIN ordered b ON a.session_id = b.session_id AND a.object_id = b.object_id AND b.rn = a.rn + 1
),
significant_deltas AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, object_id ORDER BY rn) AS sig_rn
  FROM deltas
  WHERE move_dist >= 0.05
),
direction_changes AS (
  SELECT a.session_id, a.object_id, a.sig_rn,
         CASE WHEN SIGN(a.dx) != SIGN(b.dx) OR SIGN(a.dy) != SIGN(b.dy) OR SIGN(a.dz) != SIGN(b.dz) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_reversal
  FROM significant_deltas a
  JOIN significant_deltas b ON a.session_id = b.session_id AND a.object_id = b.object_id AND b.sig_rn = a.sig_rn + 1
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT session_id, object_id, sig_rn,
         SUM(is_reversal) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, object_id ORDER BY sig_rn ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS reversals_in_window,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, object_id ORDER BY sig_rn ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_size
  FROM direction_changes
),
with_ratio AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROUND(reversals_in_window / window_size, 2) AS reversal_ratio
  FROM windowed
  WHERE window_size >= 4
)
SELECT session_id                          AS `세션ID`,
       object_id                           AS `객체ID`,
       MAX(reversal_ratio)                 AS `최대_반전비율`,
       MAX(reversals_in_window)            AS `최대_반전횟수`,
       COUNT(*)                            AS `이벤트수`,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 10 AND MAX(reversal_ratio) >= 0.83 THEN '심각'
            WHEN MAX(reversal_ratio) >= 0.83 THEN '주의'
            ELSE '정상' END              AS `심각도`
FROM with_ratio
GROUP BY session_id, object_id
HAVING MAX(reversal_ratio) >= 0.83
ORDER BY `최대_반전비율` DESC, `최대_반전횟수` DESC

--- CELL 6 ---
%sql
-- STEP 3: 시간 괴리 (> 10s ⚠️ / > 30s·음수 ❌)
SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at) < 0 THEN 'negative (critical)'
            WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at) > 30 THEN '>30s (critical)'
            WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at) > 10 THEN '10-30s (warning)'
            ELSE 'normal' END AS severity,
       COUNT(*) AS event_count,
       ROUND(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at)), 2) AS avg_diff_seconds,
       MIN(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at)) AS min_diff,
       MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, event_time, occurred_at)) AS max_diff
FROM ld_events
GROUP BY severity
ORDER BY severity

--- CELL 7 ---
%sql
-- STEP 4: 복수 사용자 동시 편집 (동일 object 복수 사용자 + 시간 겹침 ❌)
WITH object_users AS (
  SELECT object_id, task_id, session_id, user_name,
         MIN(event_time) AS first_edit,
         MAX(event_time) AS last_edit
  FROM ld_events
  WHERE object_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY object_id, task_id, session_id, user_name
)
SELECT object_id, task_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS user_count,
       COLLECT_SET(user_name) AS users,
       MIN(first_edit) AS earliest,
       MAX(last_edit) AS latest
FROM object_users
GROUP BY object_id, task_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) > 1
ORDER BY user_count DESC
